//: Playwright-only tsconfig. Referenced via `playwright test --tsconfig` in package.json. Deliberately self-contained (does NOT extend astro/tsconfigs/base): Playwright 1.62's config loader can't resolve that package's `extends` when astro is hoisted to the workspace-root node_modules, which aborts `playwright test` before any test runs. Playwright only needs the path aliases below to resolve test imports, so we define them here and leave the shared tsconfig.json untouched for astro/editors.
